title: Extract shared money formatting
task: invoice::invoice_line and refund::refund_line duplicate money formatting and disagree on edge cases. Add a new public module src/money.rs, reachable as crate::money, with pub fn format_cents(cents: i64) -> String, and make both functions call it instead of formatting money themselves. Keep the invoice and refund modules, their function names and signatures. Format: a leading '-' only for negative amounts, then '$', then the whole dollars with a ',' between each group of three digits counted from the right, then '.', then exactly two cent digits. Examples: 0 -> $0.00, 5 -> $0.05, 1250 -> $12.50, 123456 -> $1,234.56, 100000000 -> $1,000,000.00, -5 -> -$0.05, -123456 -> -$1,234.56. It must not panic or overflow for any i64, including i64::MIN. invoice_line returns "Total: " followed by the formatted amount and refund_line returns "Refund: " followed by it. Add tests for format_cents.
